evidence.excerpt: I’m excited to share that Osmaura has joined Y Combinator’s S26 batch. Yeabkal and I left MIT last semester to work on our startup together full time. We spent months in pivot hell, chasing ideas, throwing things away, and trying to find a problem that felt both important and real. After months of trying, we've landed on a problem that's exciting to us. Law firm partners are under constant pressure to originate more work, stay close to clients, and spot new matter opportunities week after…
